notes.title: Demo Update 0.4!
notes.notes:
This update adds new control and accessibility options, thanks to valuable feedback from the community!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503813/8221e5c1a3da11dc9448691ba3a2aa5a5422a643.jpg"]

Features:

New TOGGLE setting, allowing players to lock buttons down with a quick tap.

New LAYOUT setting, allowing players to rearrange button placement.

New ICON styles.

Support for macOS!



Adjustments:

Default button layout has been updated to better reflect button positions.

Time Attack button now loads level instantly.

Training Twist level renamed to "Trainyard Twist".

Improved art assets throughout.

Minor font adjustments.


Meanwhile, work is continuing steadily towards the full release! Hope to share more soon!
